title: hymenopappus filifolius var. polycephalus
intro: Hymenopappus filifolius var. polycephalus, commonly known as the many-headed fleabane, is a perennial plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and rheumatism, due to its numerous health benefits, such as its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hymenopappus filifolius var. polycephalus include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and acting as an antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
